mapper.insert: insert into user_prompt_rule (user_id, rule_type, rule_value, scope, status, source, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{ruleType}, #{ruleValue}, #{scope}, #{status}, #{source}, now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from user_prompt_rule r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1
mapper.update: update user_prompt_rule set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.delete: delete from user_prompt_rule where user_id = #{userId} and rule_id = #{ruleId}
delete from user_prompt_rule where user_id = #{userId} and source = #{source}
